Feature: Interrupts can be generated based on positive edge or negative edge or level high or level low detection at GPIO input
Test Description: Configures GPIO pins 8–39 as inputs with negative-edge interrupt detection. For each pin, clears any pending raw interrupt, enables the per-pin interrupt, drives the pad to create a falling edge from high to low, and waits with a bounded timeout for the interrupt. The interrupt service routine verifies the input reads low, that the raw and group interrupt status reflect the event, clears both the per-pin and group raw status, and clears the platform interrupt before returning. The test ends by reporting accumulated errors.
Remarks: The wait is armed before driving the falling edge to avoid races. A bounded timeout of 5000 iterations with 10-unit waits is used while waiting for the interrupt. The pad driver register at 0xA0243ffc is used to generate edges and is restored to all-high after handling. Instance selection is controlled by compile-time options that also choose the platform interrupt ID and the system interrupt bits.
Test Steps / Procedure: Entry: test function is invoked for the GPIO negative-edge interrupt enable scenario.
Enable the platform interrupt for the selected GPIO instance via INTR_EN1 and the platform interrupt controller.
Initialize the pad driver register at 0xA0243ffc to drive all outputs high.

For each pin from 8 to 39: write the per-pin control register (GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 for the current pin) to set input mode, enable negative-edge interrupt, and clear per-pin raw status, then wait 10 time units.
For each pin from 8 to 39: clear the group raw interrupt bit for the current pin using GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1.
For each pin from 8 to 39: enable only the current pin’s interrupt in GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, then wait 10 time units.
Before generating the falling edge, mark the interrupt as pending in software to start the wait window.
Generate a falling edge for the current pin by first driving all pads high via 0xA0243ffc, waiting 30 time units, then driving the current pin low while others remain high using 0xA0243ffc.
Wait for the interrupt to be serviced with a bounded loop: up to 5000 iterations, sleeping 10 time units per iteration, exiting when the ISR clears the pending flag.
If the timeout expires, record an error for the current pin and continue to the next pin.
Interrupt handling: upon the interrupt, clear the software pending indicator and restore the pad driver at 0xA0243ffc to all-high.
Read the per-pin control/status register for the current pin (GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 for the current pin) and verify the input-data field indicates low following a falling edge.
If the per-pin raw interrupt field indicates an event, read the group masked interrupt status (GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1) and verify that the bit corresponding to the current pin is set.

Clear the per-pin raw status by writing the per-pin control register to keep input mode and assert the per-pin clear field; also clear the group raw status for the current pin via GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1.
Re-read GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1 and verify it is cleared.
Clear the system-level raw status via RAW_STCR1 for the selected instance and clear the platform interrupt in the interrupt controller.
If the per-pin raw interrupt field was not set, record an error.
Impacted Registers: INTR_EN1, GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8, GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1, RAW_STCR1
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: While waiting after generating the falling edge, the wait terminates before the timeout elapses (bounded at 5000 iterations with 10-unit waits).
In the interrupt handler for the current pin, the input-data field in the per-pin control/status register indicates low after the falling edge.
The group masked interrupt status shows the bit corresponding to the current pin set during servicing.
After clearing per-pin raw status and the group raw status, the group masked interrupt status reads as cleared.
System-level raw status and the platform interrupt are cleared during servicing.
Overall pass condition: the final reported error count is zero.

name: test_gpio_negedge_intr_en
objective: Verify negative-edge interrupt enable and handling for GPIO pins 8–39 including status/clear behavior and platform interrupt handling.
preconditions: Platform interrupt controller and system interrupt infrastructure available; GPIO instance selection defined at compile time; pad driver address 0xA0243ffc accessible.
expected_results: No timeouts; each ISR observes low input on the pin after falling edge; group status sets for the active pin; status clears after servicing; final error count is zero.
pass_fail_criteria: Pass if final error count is zero; any timeout or status mismatch constitutes fail.
